name: AgriOS
description: AgriOS is an open-source, subscription-free ERP designed for African agri-SMEs. It integrates business operations with traceability to improve efficiency, ensure compliance, and unlock access to finance.

name: CKAN
description: CKAN is an Open Source Data Management System to build Data Portals. Trusted by hundreds of portals across the world and supported by an active community, it focuses on extensibility and integration with other tools.

name: Compar:IA
description: Compar:IA is a conversational AI arena where users can explore and compare over 30 different models. Its mission is to promote awareness of model pluralism, bias, and environmental impact, while simultaneously building one of the world’s largest non-english alignment datasets.

name: CREDEBL
description: The CREDEBL platform helps Governments and private entities implement a digital, foundational identity issuance and verification solution in a cost effective way by leveraging W3C Standards.

name: Dalgo
description: Dalgo is an open-source data platform for the social sector which enables organisations to learn from and represent their impact effectively by automating data flow and data management processes.

name: Data Norge
description: Data.norge.no provides a comprehensive overview of datasets, concepts, APIs, information models, services, and events in the public sector, including protected data. It helps you discover, assess, and make use of data.

name: DEXA Protocol
description: DEXA protocol is key for developing and deploying trustworthy, human-centric decentralised data applications (dApps) across domains using data intermediation services within dataspaces.

name: DIGIT
description: DIGIT is an open-source, configurable, extendable, modular, digital infrastructure that enables local governments to deliver municipal services to citizens in an efficient, inclusive, and transparent manner.

name: Digital Impact Exchange
description: This is an interactive, multitenant online platform designed to simplify the discovery and evaluation of digital options. It serves as a comprehensive resource for people working to tracking their digital footprint by providing a catalog, a marketplace, and a resource library.

name: DKAN
description: DKAN is a powerful, community-driven open data platform. As a Drupal module, DKAN leverages Drupal's robust features to create modern, standards-focused, and API-first open data catalogs for a variety of specific use cases.

name: Docs - Collaborative Text Editing
description: Docs is a collaborative text editor designed to address common challenges in knowledge building and sharing.

name: ekShop Marketplace
description: ekShop marketplace is a robust and adaptable eCommerce platform that is free and open-source. It is designed to cater to the needs of any potential entrepreneur who wants to set up an online store quickly and efficiently. With its customizable and configurable features, ekShop can be tailored to suit your specific requirements.

name: Element
description: Element is a sovereign, interoperable and secure communications platform built on the Matrix standard. It enables organisations to control and manage messaging, voice and video with end-to-end encryption across mobile and desktop environments.

name: Eurosky Identity Platform
description: Sovereign, EU-hosted identity and data hosting for the AT Protocol: a Personal Data Server that holds each user's account and data, plus Portal, the account-creation and management interface. One account works across hundreds of apps and can move to any provider.

name: FireForm
description: FireForm is an open-source tool that saves first responders hours of administrative overhead. By using local AI to extract data from a single voice memo, it automatically populates required incident forms—ensuring total data privacy and zero redundant paperwork.

name: FUSS - Free Upgrade for a digitally Sustainable School
description: FUSS is a complete GNU/Linux solution based on Debian and around 200 educational software packages for schools. It is a project that allows students and teachers to use at home the same tools installed at school, freely and without any cost to families.

name: Health Claims Data Exchange
description: The HCX Platform by Swasth Alliance enables seamless health claims data exchange with tools like SDKs, management apps, and an exchange switch—boosting collaboration and interoperability across the health ecosystem.

name: Interfacer
description: Innovative federated open source platform that provides a digital product passport. With a focus to find and share open source hardware projects, collaborate with others, and discover new products and services. Import your projects to allow access to the community and grow your reputation.

name: IVTToken
description: This initiative connects under connected schools to the internet through a blockchain model, rewarding ISPs and sponsors with connectivity tokens. Supported by UNICEF, it focuses on usability and scalability to enhance global educational access.

name: Janssen Project
description: A low-code digital identity platform for workforce, consumer and citizen identity based on open standards like OAuth, OpenID, FIDO and SCIM.

name: JemPI
description: JeMPI is an entity matching (commonly used for patient matching) and linking technology that supports batch and transactional matching via advanced techniques though a combination of deterministic and probabilistic matching.

name: Joomla CMS
description: Joomla is a free, open‑source content management system (CMS) for building and running websites and web applications. It includes robust access control, content workflows, multilingual support, an extensible API, and built‑in privacy and security tooling.

name: KoboToolbox
description: KoboToolbox is an open source platform for the collection, management, and visualization of data. As the most widely used primary data collection tool in the nonprofit sector, it is the tool of choice for over 32,000 social impact organizations worldwide.

name: LaSuite Drive
description: Drive empowers teams to securely store, share, and collaborate on files while maintaining full control over their data through a user-friendly, open-source platform.

name: LaSuite Meet
description: Powered by LiveKit, La Suite Meet is a video conference software that offers Zoom-level performance with high-quality video and audio. No installation required—simply join calls directly from your browser.

name: LibreSign
description: LibreSign is an open-source digital and electronic signature platform that ensures secure, legally compliant document signing, tailored for businesses and institutions with full control over their data.

name: magasin
description: Magasin is a cloud native open-source end-to-end data platform. Magasin enables organizations to perform automatic data ingestion, storage, analysis, ML/AI compute and visualization at scale.

name: Mastodon
description: Mastodon is a free and open-source software platform for decentralized social networking.

name: Measuring Real Power Usage of Software Applications
description: This initiative, a system and method for measuring the real power draw and carbon emissions of software applications, allows businesses and consumers to accurately assess emissions at an individual software level providing a greater level of granularity in reporting.

name: Media Cloud
description: Media Cloud is a database of digital news from around the world and a set of open-source tools to analyze and visualize the published content.

name: Mojaloop
description: Open source software for creating payment platforms that will help unbanked people access digital financial services.

name: MOSIP
description: The Modular Open Source Identity Platform (MOSIP) helps Governments and other user organizations implement a digital, foundational identity system in a cost effective way.

name: National Carbon Credit Registry
description: The National Carbon Credit Registry is an open-source toolkit that helps countries securely issue, monitor, and trade carbon credits, ensuring data integrity.

name: Nextcloud Server
description: Nextcloud is a fully open-source and on-premises content collaboration platform. Teams access, share, and edit their documents, chat and participate in video calls, and manage their mail, calendar, and projects across mobile, desktop, and web interfaces.

name: Open Data Editor
description: Open Data Editor (ODE) is a free, open-source desktop app designed to help nonprofits, data journalists, activists, and public servants detect errors in their datasets. It is designed for people working with tabular data (Excel, Google Sheets, CSV) who don't know how to code.

name: Open Terms Archive
description: Open Terms Archive publicly records every version of the terms of digital services to enable democratic oversight.

name: Open-Pryv.io
description:
Personal Data & Privacy Management Software
A ready-to-use solution for personal data and consent management.
Pryv.io is a solid foundation on which you build your own digital health solution, so you can collect, store, share and rightfully use personal data.

name: OpenFisca
description: OpenFisca is a Rules as Code engine: it enables collaboratively making laws and regulations computable over APIs for developers, datascientists and researchers. This allows building software to help citizens and businesses understand how laws apply to them, designing better rules and public policies, debating potential reforms, and scaling economic micro-simulation.

name: openIMIS
description: openIMIS is a versatile open source software which supports the administration of health financing and social protection schemes. It is specially designed to manage the complex, high-volume data flows which are required to operate such schemes by seamlessly integrating beneficiary, provider and payer data in a single platform.

name: OpenMandriva Lx
description: A user-friendly, free, fully open and spyware free, operating system focusing on desktop/laptop computers.

name: Orthanc
description: Orthanc is a free and open-source PACS server. It is designed to improve the DICOM workflows in hospitals, and to support research and education about medical imaging. The Orthanc ecosystem also features the Stone Web viewer as an effective teleradiology environment.

name: Ozone
description: Ozone is a growing ecosystem of digital health apps (EMR, billing, pharmacy, lab, imaging, etc.) exchanging FHIR-based data to instantly build secure health information systems—with real-time analytics for actionable insights.

name: PeerTube
description: PeerTube is a tool for hosting, managing, and sharing videos or live streams.

name: Penpot
description: Penpot is the first open-source design and prototyping platform that enables true collaboration between designers and developers. Built on web standards (SVG, CSS, HTML), it provides professional design tools without vendor lock-in, available as cloud service or self-hosted.

name: QField
description: Survey and digitize data in the field with seamless synchronization QField focuses on efficiently getting GIS fieldwork done and exchanging data between the field and the office in a comfortable and user-friendly way.

name: QuarkID
description: QuarkID is the digital trust framework developed by the Government of the City of Buenos Aires that creates a new digital identity system and gives people control over their information, with a security anchor through blockchain.

name: Rafiki
description: Rafiki is open source software that financial service providers run to add Interledger functionality to the accounts they service. It implements the Open Payments API and the Interledger Protocol, connecting providers across different payment networks.

name: Rahat
description: Rahat is a collection of open-source, blockchain-powered projects for cash and aid distribution and management. It enables the efficient and transparent coordination of resources and relief efforts. By leveraging token-based transfers, Rahat supports anticipatory cash and voucher

name: Rocky Linux
description: Rocky Linux is a community-driven, enterprise-grade, free and open source operating system compatible with established Enterprise Linux standards.

name: SanteSuite
description:
SanteSuite (SanteIMS & SanteMPI) is an essential suite of products for national digital health infrastructure components that leverages a unique identity to facilitate data consolidation, harmonization, sharing, and building health information exchanges (e.g., OpenHIE) to establish interoperability across multiple software solutions.

SanteIMS - is an immunization management system and EIR platform that supports the management of any type and scale of vaccination program including pandemic response, such as COVID-19 vaccination.

SanteMPI - Master Patient Index/Client Registry (MPI/CR) platform designed to overcome barriers to leveraging person-centered data as a catalyst for transforming health systems.

name: SimpleAudit
description: Lightweight AI safety auditing framework for red-teaming AI systems through adversarial probing. Supports multilingual testing across safety, healthcare, and RAG scenarios. Works with cloud APIs or fully local models.

name: SMILE
description: SMILE is a Digital Public Health Platform to Strengthen National Health Supply Chain and Logistics Management

name: Statbus
description: Statbus is a web application for statistical offices, assisting and enabling them to build and maintain a business register that is the backbone for national accounts and economic statistics.

name: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server
description: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server is an open Linux operating system that is secure and adaptable for long-term support and innovation-ready infrastructure running business-critical workloads on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge.

name: Syft
description: Syft allows external researchers to securely conduct remote data science while protecting privacy, security, and intellectual property.

name: Tor Browser
description: Tor advances human rights and protects users' privacy on the internet by hiding the connection between their internet address and the services they use.

name: Trade Trust
description: TradeTrust is an open-source software that digitizes international trade documents, reducing paperwork, documentation costs, and the risks of fraud. TradeTrust enables industry to verify a document's authenticity and create Electronic Transferable Records (ETRs).

name: TrueNAS
description: TrueNAS is the world's most deployed storage software with millions of users, including the majority of F500 companies, delivering scalable and fully-capable unified storage for valuable data.

name: TYPO3
description: TYPO3 is a powerful, open-source CMS backed by a vibrant professional community and commercial ecosystem. Built for enterprise, it fulfills the security and service needs of a modern business, while its feature-rich core delivers across sectors, industries, and organizations.

name: UPYOG
description: The Urban Platform for DeliverY of Online Governance (UPYOG) is a set of Open APIs, services, and reference implementations, setup as a public good, to allow government entities, businesses, startups, and civil society to use a unique digital Infrastructure and build solutions at a large scale. Developed under the National Urban Digital Mission, MoHUA to facilitate the digital delivery of G2G, G2C, G2B services focussing on citizen centricity, UPYOG is available with customizable 14 reference modules.

name: VaccineLedger
description: VaccineLedger is a decentralized supply chain management platform that leverages blockchain technology, Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Technology to capture data for every vaccine and other medical products in the supply chains from manufacturer to the beneficiary.

name: WSO2 Identity Server
description: WSO2 Identity Server is an open-source Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution supporting secure authentication, identity federation, and user management via open standards such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM 2.0, and FIDO2.

name: X-Road®
description: X-Road® is open-source software that provides unified and secure data exchange between organisations in a collaborative ecosystem.
